concepts.gloss_en: Heels (plural) — the aspect of din (judgment), equated with raglin (legs/feet) in Torah 41

members.note: plural 'heels'; consistently בחינת דין in lm1:41

concepts.gloss_en: Heel (singular) — appears as בחינת דל (Torah 177) and בחינת רגלין (Torah 22); distinct number and distinct local equations from the plural עקבים

members.note: singular 'heel'; different number than עקבים and different contextual equations (dal / raglin) across separate Torahs

notes: Singular עקב vs plural עקבים are the same lexeme ('heel') but each carries different Torah-specific equations (עקבים=din in Torah 41; עקב=dal in Torah 177, =raglin in Torah 22). Number differs and merges hold only per-Torah, so kept separate per the under-merge and local-equation rules. A human may choose to link them as singular/plural of one body-part concept.
